description: This file contains a source code fix provider class for the Roslyn analyzer, which provides automated code fixes related to attribute usage in C# source code.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseCodeFix
classes.description: A CodeFixProvider implementation that provides code fixes for incorrect attribute usage.

methods.name: FixableDiagnosticIds
methods.description: Property indicating which diagnostic IDs this code fix can handle.

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Provides a FixAllProvider for batch fixing.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously registers code fixes for diagnostics.

methods.name: FixableDiagnosticIds
methods.description: Return list of diagnostic IDs that this code fix can address (related to IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer.RuleId).

methods.name: GetFixAllProvider
methods.description: Returns the WellKnownFixAllProviders.BatchFixer for batch fixing.

methods.name: RegisterCodeFixesAsync
methods.description: Registers a code fix action that removes the parent node of an AttributeSyntax node when an incorrect attribute use is detected.
